name: lessenc-digital
description: Plataforma digital inicial da L'Essenc para venda de infoprodutos autorais.

scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/p06-db-guard.mjs dev && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:test: node scripts/p06-db-guard.mjs test-deploy && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:fresh: node scripts/p06-db-guard.mjs fresh-deploy && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status: node scripts/p06-db-guard.mjs status && prisma migrate status
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/p06-db-guard.mjs test && npm run db:generate && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check
